text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 473 million markka median forecast for steel group Rautaruukki Oy's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on October 21 at 1000/0700 GMT.
In January-August 1995, Rautaruukki posted a 605 million markka profit.
For Rautaruukki's full-year 1996 profit, eight of the 12 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 655 million markka (mean 660 million) in a 619-733 million markka range.
Rautaruukki's 1995 profit before extraordinary items was 954 million markka.

The data was collected in the first two weeks of October. Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros, Enskilda, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities and Opstock.
